g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 1 | Four Stages from Maker to Successor
Purpose, intended users, scope and version
Rebuild: how do I run it?
Environment, dependencies, installation and startup commands
Accept: how do I know it works?
Test data, steps, expected results and actual evidence
Hand over: what about failures or shutdown?
Known limits, error handling, recovery, shutdown and cleanup
Arrows show the reading and delivery sequence, not passed acceptance.
